summary: Iteration 56 — Frontend testing of 'Configuration des réservations' section in create-service wizard (Step 3). All 16 requested features verified and passing. The booking config section is fully functional: card selection with orange highlight, expiry chips visibility toggle, amber warning box, dynamic impact block with 4 flux states, step 4 workflow badge, and correct API payload fields.
seed_data_creation: One test service created (svc_59d923ec7c6a) during submit test (Flux A: instant_booking + allow_pay_later=false). Can be deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 booking config features confirmed working on create-service wizard. Step 3 booking config section: (1) booking-mode-instant/manual cards selectable with orange highlight; (2) pay-mode-now/later cards selectable; (3) expiry chips (expiry-30/60/120/240/1440) correctly shown/hidden based on allowPayLater state; (4) amber warning box shows/hides with allowPayLater; (5) impact block updates dynamically for all 4 flux states (A=green, B=blue, C=orange, D=amber); (6) step 4 summary displays correct workflow badge; (7) POST /api/services payload includes booking_approval_mode, allow_pay_later, pay_later_expiration_minutes. Default state: manual_approval + allow_pay_later=true.
